name: Raw to Cooked Weight MCP
description: Raw to cooked weight of meat and poultry by cut and cooking method from USDA cooking yields. Tools: convert_raw_to_cooked, convert_cooked_to_raw, calculate_raw_weight_to_buy, find_cooking_yield, list_cooking_yields. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
